input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for letting us know about your dog. We've received your request to move the property inspection at Flat 12, 162 Beacon Close, Cedarford, ZZ9 5ZZ (ref R/PM020-1) from Tuesday 13/02/2024.

Just to check: 15 February 2024 is a Thursday, and Friday is 16 February. Could you reply to confirm which date you'd prefer, and whether a morning slot still suits you?

Until we confirm a new date in writing, please treat the current booking as unchanged. We'll check the inspector's availability and come back to you with confirmation by Friday 9 February.

Kind regards,
Oakfield Services
